name: MANTRA
author: L'Cronx
summary: A rhythmic multi-effect: a pattern chops, filters, crushes, delays and glitches the sound in time with the song. Two layers of six effects (filter, distortion, delay, lo-fi, flanger, glitch) in any order, eight 32-step modulators locked to the song, a 24-slot matrix, per-page randomiser, 419 factory presets plus unlimited own. MPC OS 3.x.
